name: Ring Pull-Up
steps: Grip a pair of hanging gymnastic rings set above head height at roughly shoulder width and hang with straight arms and palms facing forward.
Set your shoulder blades down, brace your core, and pull your chest smoothly up toward the rings.
Let the rings turn as you pull until your chin clears your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full dead hang as your palms return naturally forward.
tips: Use the free rotation of the rings to find the most comfortable path for your elbows and shoulders.
Keep your legs still and avoid kipping or swinging upward.
